The problem requires tracking the cost of making the string "good" by ensuring exactly one pair of consecutive characters are the same. The dp array should be simplified to a 2D array to track the minimum cost for each position in the string, considering whether the character is flipped or not. The specification should also clarify how to handle the transitions between states to ensure only one pair of consecutive characters are the same.

  4. Initialize an integer array C of length N and populate it with integers read from input.
  5. Initialize a 2D integer array dp with dimensions [N][2], where dp[i][0] represents the minimum cost to make the string "good" up to the i-th character without flipping it, and dp[i][1] represents the cost with flipping.
